purpose: Define the only admissible pre-execution circuit representations for the 8,767-row archived-real-QPU corpus. This contract prevents a width, family label, or reconstructed circuit from being silently treated as an exact source circuit.

out_of_scope: method-specific formula, snapshot, CLOPS, and clock decisions owned by S60
split construction and statistical estimands owned by S59
final method-by-row eligibility owned by S62

normative_terms.exact: The bytes or an immutable source record identify the circuit representation actually submitted or recorded before the archived execution.
normative_terms.archive_resolved_recipe: A hash join identifies an archived benchmark family and logical width, then a version-pinned generator creates a declared logical recipe. It is not inverse transpilation and not byte-exact recovery of the original pre-transpile QASM.
normative_terms.pinned_structural_reconstruction: A version-pinned source and recorded configuration deterministically yield an angle-insensitive circuit structure, but not the submitted route, optimizer angles, or exact submitted QASM.
normative_terms.unavailable: The required representation cannot be established before execution from immutable source evidence. It must be reported as unavailable, never replaced by an inferred width or a newly chosen circuit.

eligible_uses: unified adaptations whose S62 method contract accepts exact logical DAG/features
prohibited_claims: job-day calibration recovery from a later FakeBackend snapshot

qonductor_p0_submitted_physical_qasm.input_pointer: Qonductor circuits.zip member named by canonical qasm_path_or_member
eligible_uses: unified adaptations accepting submitted physical DAG/features
snapshot transpilation or schedule estimation when permitted by S60/S62
not_eligible_for: claims that P0 reveals the original logical MQTBench instance

qonductor_l1_archive_resolved_logical_re.resolution_mechanism: Exact SHA-256 equality joins submitted physical QASM to Qonductor benchmarks.zip member family_backend_logical-width.qasm; the pinned MQTBench 1.0.3 generator then produces the declared logical recipe.
qonductor_l1_archive_resolved_logical_re.execution_release_gate: blocked_until_each_generated recipe passes the frozen MQTBench-1.0.3 round-trip/structural validation and receives a generated_recipe_digest; this S58 contract does not itself materialize or execute L1 inputs.
eligible_uses: separately labelled Qonductor L1 Ma-Li-style logical-DAG diagnostic
logical-recipe leakage grouping in addition to submitted-QASM grouping
not_eligible_for: literal recovery or byte-exact reproduction of Qonductor original logical QASM
a replacement logical input for L2 or L4 rows
an unlabelled row in a full-Qonductor logical-DAG leaderboard

eligible_uses: separately labelled structural sensitivity, if a later method contract explicitly accepts it
not_eligible_for: input substitution for a method requiring graph seed or exact logical instance
logical-DAG adaptation requiring original/reconstructed logical input

eligible_uses: unified adaptations whose S62 method contract accepts a pinned structural DAG/features
not_eligible_for: compiled-route or optimizer-angle-dependent method without a declared reconstruction step
literal source-native fidelity table for an estimator absent from QPack

qonductor_set_relation.invariant: P0 overlaps every L tier. L1 + L2 + L4 must equal 4,482; these are not additive rows beyond P0.

deprecated_nonidentity_view.name: 3,065 family-level candidates
deprecated_nonidentity_view.forbidden_use: row-to-runtime mapping, exact logical identity, or execution manifest

unified_adaptation_boundary.principle: The unified 8,767-row ledger retains all observations. A method may use the strongest declared pre-execution representation available for that source only when its S62 cell records the representation_id, lifecycle_stage, and coverage. Representation differences are not erased.

native_fidelity_boundary.qpack: dataset source only; no QPack runtime-estimator native fidelity cell

diagnostic_boundary.qonductor_l2: 14-row structural sensitivity only, never merged with L1
diagnostic_boundary.qpack: angle-insensitive pinned structural representation; workflow grouped

forbidden_inferences: Infer an exact logical QASM from logical width, physical width, backend capacity, family name, depth, shots, or runtime.
Use Qonductor backend_qubits or aggregate width_qubits as a circuit logical width.
Attach a new MQTBench circuit to a Qonductor row without an L1 archive-hash join.
Treat QPack workflow ID as a QASM hash, target feature, or exact circuit identity.
Invent QPack optimizer angles, transpiler routing, or submitted physical circuit bytes.
Call an adaptation a literal Ma-Li replication outside the Ma-Li exact-logical source.

materialization_schema.uniqueness_rule: One row per canonical_observation_id and representation_id. Multiple representation rows are permitted only when each has distinct explicit representation_id.
materialization_schema.no_target_leakage_rule: No reconstructed representation, digest, generator parameter, feature, or eligibility decision may use target_seconds or any held-out observed runtime.

supersession.effect: For the 230 L1 rows only, this contract supersedes older blanket exclusions of Qonductor from a separately labelled logical-recipe diagnostic. It does not alter historical artifacts or promote L1 to an exact-original logical-QASM claim.

acceptance_tests.requirement: Canonical source counts are Ma-Li=340, Qonductor=4,482, QPack=3,945 and total=8,767.
Exactly 4,482 Qonductor P0 ledger records have a nonempty archive member and recomputed submitted-QASM SHA-256 equal to canonical qasm_bytes_sha256.
Exactly L1=230, L2=14 and L4=4,238 Qonductor records; their union is 4,482 and each is also P0.
Every L1 record resolves to one audit row with matching submitted hash, benchmark archive member, family, logical width, pinned MQTBench 1.0.3 wheel hash and reproducible generated recipe digest.
Rows sharing a submitted-QASM hash or generated logical-recipe digest are assigned to one leakage group before S59 splits are materialized.
No L2/L4 record has a generated logical recipe path/digest or is marked eligible for the L1 logical-recipe diagnostic.
Every QPack record maps to one validated pinned (problem,size,p,backend,shots,num_qubits,depth) configuration and one workflow group; qasm_bytes_sha256 remains empty.

No ledger field called logical_qasm_path, exact_qasm_hash, or logical_width_source is populated for Qonductor L2/L4 or QPack unless its value is explicitly a non-exact reconstruction identifier with the matching provenance flag.

Reordering source rows leaves representation records and input digests unchanged; changing a pinned archive member, generator revision, generator version, or structural configuration changes the representation digest.
Static audit confirms no reconstruction/materialization function reads target_seconds, target_native, or an observed runtime field.
